_about: Game rules. Every number the engine uses lives here. Change, reload, start a new game (a saved game keeps the rules it started with).

board._about: Patients are maps of (2 x radius + 1) squares a side, start in the centre.

deck._about: Each element walks mostly in its own direction; opposite elements walk opposite ways (water and fire, earth and air). Patterns are steps from the walker's view: ahead, left, right. Each pattern makes one card per element.

patients._value: A patient is worth (steps from the centre - 1), plus bonusValue if it has bonusAtOni or more oni.
patients._moves: How often each move type comes up on patients (weights). step: 1 square · stride: 2 · jump: 2 squares, leaping the square between · any: 1 square any way · lucky: 1 square, +1 mon if that brew cures.
patients._ailmentKinds: How many different ailments are in play each game (fewer = more repeats for known cures). null = all.
patients._requireElement: A cure needs at least one ingredient of the patient's element (Kitsune Tail counts as any).

curse._about: Quarter turns a curse may apply: 1 = clockwise, 2 = half, 3 = anticlockwise.

ward._about: Cured patients join your ward and can be played as moves. uses: times each can be played (null = once every brew, like a garden card).

knownCure._about: Cure a patient whose ailment you have cured before, without ingredients, for payout x its value (rounded down, at least 1). Spends that ward patient's move.

guilds._about: echo: once per brew, one garden card of your guild's element may be played twice.

tools._about: Paid with fame. effect: turn (play a card rotated by one of 'turns' quarter turns), step (one free step any way), gather (take 'amount' cards when gathering). Each works once per brew. copies: how many of each exist; null = players - 1.

abilities._about: What a character's ability changes, as additions to the rules above for that player only. Themes decide which character has which ability. Keys: gardenMax, handLimit, startHand, oniPerPlayer, gather, sakuraBonus, toolCost, startFame, startGarden.

bot._about: The rival stops buying tools once it is this close to winning.
